name: National Emergency Number
description: All-in-one unified emergency number across India integrating Police, Fire, Ambulance, and Disaster management with GPS location dispatch.

name: Police Helpline
description: Direct Police emergency response for reporting crimes in progress, public safety threats, theft, or urgent law and order assistance.

name: Fire & Rescue Service
description: Fire brigade emergency dispatch for structural fires, industrial hazards, explosions, and immediate building rescue operations.

name: Maternal & Child Medical Ambulance
description: Dedicated free government ambulance and medical transport for pregnant mothers, newborns, and pediatric emergencies (Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram).

name: Disaster & Medical Trauma Ambulance
description: Emergency trauma care and disaster ambulance equipped with advanced life support, oxygen, and paramedic response.

name: Women in Distress Helpline
description: Special police response line for women facing stalking, domestic threat, street harassment, or requiring emergency police protection.

name: Childline India
description: 24/7 toll-free emergency response service for children in need of care and protection, rescuing child labour, abuse victims, and lost kids.

name: National Women Helpline (WCD)
description: Toll-free 24-hour telecom service providing 24/7 counselling, shelter home referrals, legal aid, and One-Stop-Centre (Sakhi) support to women.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline
description: Immediate helpline to report financial cyber fraud, UPI/OTP scams, unauthorized bank debits, and freeze stolen money in transit.

name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
description: Department of Consumer Affairs guidance line for registering grievances against e-commerce fraud, defective items, and deficient services.

name: Elderline (Senior Citizen Helpline)
description: National helpline for senior citizens offering emotional support, abuse rescue, legal guidance under Senior Citizens Maintenance Act, and shelter.

name: RBI Banking Ombudsman Helpline
description: Reserve Bank of India helpline for unresolved banking grievances, ATM failed reversal delays, and unlawful recovery agent harassment.

name: Railway Passenger Helpline (RailMadad)
description: Integrated passenger assistance for security, medical emergency on train, coach cleanliness, and railway grievance redressal.

name: National Highway Accident Helpline
description: NHAI 24x7 emergency helpline for highway accidents, vehicle breakdown tow assistance, and route clearance on national expressways.
